chunks.text: I was just reminiscing about that quick hop from Beijing to Shanghai back in 2025—felt like I lived in the airport that week.
And yeah, once I landed, we basically ate our way through Shanghai the whole time.
Funny part is, right before that trip I’d also been comparing places to stay around Beijing, just out of curiosity.
My coworker handled the actual ticket though—Air China, flight CA1456, if I’m remembering it right.
It was for 2025-03-13, and it was under Zhang Wei—everything was already set by the time I saw it.
The next day, 2025-03-14 at 12:00, I remember we squeezed in lunch at Xiao Nan Guo—just me, so party size was 1.
The reservation details were kind of hilarious—contact name Zhang Wei, phone 13822970109, and the place was listed as Xiao Nan Guo in the system.

Totally unrelated, but I also remember checking my card balance afterward—account number 6217001234567890—and later that month my friend Chen Ming stayed at Home Inn Dongzhimen starting 2025-03-27 for 5 nights.
